findings.description: RecordControl moved to `.transport.right` in titlebar (App.tsx line 1340); matches required placement.

Default `askWhereToSave` is `false` (settings.ts line 36) and `saveRecordingAuto` writes to `<sessions root>/recordings` with traversal guard (`sanitizeRecordingFilename` throws on `.` / `..` / empty). Durable fix for the recording destination contract.

`nextBoundaryDelayMs` (beatSwitch.ts) aligns to next boundary using `Math.floor(nowCycle + EPS) + 1`; falls back to fixed interval when `cps <= 0` or transport stopped. Tests cover quarter-through-bar, exact-boundary, half-bar cases.

testing_summary: Tests cover phase-aligned boundary math, traversal guard, auto-save path, dialog preference round-trip, and titlebar placement; no failures observed in review (tests not executed per gate rules).
risk_rationale: Well-bounded durable fix: pure math helper, guarded filesystem path, explicit settings default, no authorization or privacy exposure.
